dimensions.question: Can a first-time reader explain the difference between shared identity and private relationship context?
Does the preview distinguish current product documentation from the live research instance and future architecture?
Does every example preserve the repository's anonymization and secret-handling rules?
Does the visual communicate continuity without turning memory into spectacle?
Does the story remain legible when the wide and square assets stack?

decision_rule: Accept only when claim_safety and privacy pass and no weighted dimension is below 3/5; human review decides promotion.
